resume.name: Chloe Ng
resume.summary: Technology associate with transferable experience in SIEM, incident triage and log analysis. Used SIEM and incident triage to monitor security alerts. Applied log analysis to triage suspicious activity and documented decisions for technical and business reviewers. Collaborated with four colleagues to analyse endpoint and network logs and presented progress during fortnightly reviews. Supported recurring operational work using network security and documented step-by-step procedures. Investigated service requests, recorded findings and escalated issues with clear supporting evidence. Created a simple reporting template that reduced manual preparation time by 29%. Built a fictional demonstration project using SIEM, incident triage and log analysis. Tested the project with representative scenarios and recorded limitations and next steps. Presented the design and outcomes to a five-person peer review group. Coursework included software engineering, databases, cybersecurity and applied analytics.
